rationale: The agent did authenticate the user (looked up by name and ZIP, retrieved user and order details) and targeted a plausible item for exchange. However, it submitted the exchange (exchange_delivered_order_items) without first obtaining explicit confirmation from the user, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. Additionally, the final message asserts that the price difference will be refunded to the credit card without showing tool-backed pricing evidence. These issues mean the request was not completed in line with the stated policy.
